summary: Explicit memory_store, memory_search, and memory_read are implemented and the fresh-session exec flow uses the memory-tool boundary to persist and retrieve stored memory.
notes: memory_store appends authoritative entries and refreshes the workspace projection immediately.
memory_search ranks hits workspace-first and returns stable entry ids for follow-up reads.

The fresh-session exec proof uses deterministic provider transport only to force the memory tool calls; persistence and retrieval are still exercised through the real CLI entrypoint and tool boundary.
